title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE SHITJE ASTIR UNAZA E RE
description_sq:
APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE SHITJE ASTIR UNAZA E RE
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te nje pallati 8 katesh me ashensor te vititi 2016 shume te mire administruar.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor qe ben shperndarjen e 2 dhomave te gjumit ,sallon ,2tualet si dhe 2 ballkone ,disponon dhe tarracen 100 m/2 e cila eshte e investuar nga fillimi me sistem lageshtire -pllak ,si dhe nje depo 10 m/2 e mbyllur per magazinim ,tarraca eshte e gjitha me sistem shkarikimi uji me pjerresin e duhur.
Apartamenti ka orientim ne pozicionin e perendimit ,dhe aktulisht i dhene me nje qera shume te mire.
Disponon te gjitha dokumentat hipotekore te rregullta.
Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni .
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE ASTIR NEW RING
description_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE ASTIR NEW RING The apartment is located on the 8th floor of an 8-story building with an elevator from 2016, very well managed. The apartment is organized in a corridor that distributes 2 bedrooms, a living room, 2 toilets and 2 balconies, it also has a 100 m/2 terrace, which is invested from the beginning with a wet-tile system, as well as a 10 m/2 warehouse closed for storage, the terrace is all with a water drainage system with the right slope. The apartment has orientation in the west position, and is currently given with a very good rent. It has all the regular mortgage documents. For a visit to the property, contact me.
